title: Automation Scheme Studio — control-circuit search
summary: A deterministic control-system builder and simulator. Bundle-generated code forms an immutable recursive topology (sequence, parallel, repeat, feedback) which the SUT compiles into a real circuit and runs against an excitation battery.

source.revision_resolution: Resolved through BUNDLE_SUT_ROOT (never a machine-specific absolute path). AUTOMATION_STUDIO_ROOT overrides the project directly.

lifecycle.install: none for the Bundle path — bootstrap.py adds <sut>/src to sys.path; `pip install -e .` only for standalone use
lifecycle.start: none — the SUT is an in-process library; each candidate builds and runs its own circuit
lifecycle.stop: none — no process outlives a candidate

determinism.reset: Each candidate constructs a fresh SearchPlan and circuit; nothing is shared between candidates.
determinism.seed: The excitation battery, duration and dt are fixed per scenario in the spec's HEAD (family/battery/duration/dt).
caveats: Floating-point simulation: verdicts are threshold comparisons on simulated signals, so results are reproducible on one host but sensitive to a change of numeric library.

oracle.description: The SUT's own Oracle evaluates the simulated response and emits seven objectives (control/robustness/stability score, settling time, worst error, overshoot, control effort) plus a verdict code.
oracle.independence: PARTIAL — the oracle ships with the SUT and shares its simulation code, so it is not independent of the thing it judges. It detects circuits that fail to build, produce non-finite signals, or miss acceptance limits; it cannot detect a systematic error in the simulator itself. This is the weakest oracle in the canonical set and is why the set is not limited to it.

known_pass: advanced_feedback/00_smoke: 32 generated, at least one Oracle PASS, full chain green
known_fail: advanced_feedback/01_operator_smoke: 8 generated, 4 PASS — the 4 non-PASS are declared domain rejections, not defects

cleanup: python generator_trunk/bundle_run.py cleanup <run-dir>; campaign reports go to an ignored campaign_results/ directory.
caveats: Requires the sibling SUT checkout pinned by revision. CI checks it out explicitly and runs both the oracle tests and a bounded full-chain smoke.
The heavier 10_third_order_brace and 20_grouped_repetition scenarios have runtime-unknown cardinality and are deliberately NOT in the gate set.
Its campaign launcher passes --unleash-initial-productivity-power, which makes hard budget gates advisory. That is a launcher choice, not an engine default.
